Business areas
The business areas reflect the group's activities in retail banking, property finance and equipment leasing.
Complementary business areas
Banking activities
Banking activities cover advisory services and financial solutions for personal customers, private clients and corporate customers. They also include trading and investment services for institutional customers.
Property finance activities
Property finance activities comprise residential and commercial real-estate lending delivered through Meridian Mortgage Services. The services are aimed at households, companies and housing associations.
Leasing activities
Leasing activities cover vehicle financing and the leasing of machinery and operating equipment for business customers. The activities also support selected dealer partnerships.
